svg.title: Gaussian FSK with a silent pause

cc:Work.dc:title: Gaussian FSK with a silent pause
cc:Work.dc:description: Bits in each illustrative 1 Mbaud burst change the transmitted frequency smoothly. The transmitter is silent between bursts.
